Every uploader invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on PutObject to that bucket. The committed template (intended state) sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to !Ref OutputBucket, and commit 724bd1b reverted the bad value. The live configuration therefore drifted from the IaC, most likely via an out-of-band update. Commit e26671f is the original commit that introduced the bad bucket name. The other three functions' live configuration matches the template, and their IAM roles and code showed no anomaly in this window.
